## Review checklist (CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] `node build-app.js` and `node build-usage.js` succeed (exit code checked)
- [ ] `node check-system.js` and `node check-spec.js` pass
- [ ] `npm test` passes: visual snapshot, every page, accessibility (no new issues)
- [ ] Meant to look different: visual baseline updated on purpose and listed under *Changed (visual)*
- [ ] Design system page complete (no "Not written yet" on a built item)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry under **Unreleased**
- [ ] Logged as a batch, with how it was verified
